unscoredIds.reason: 2026-10-29 Surface-code partial decodability under coherent Z rotations, related by Wegner duality to a decohering paramagnet. E-QEC. Over the 15-card cap after the 28 Oct carry-overs.
2026-10-29 Decoupling higher-dimensional translation-invariant CSS codes into toric codes. E-QEC theory. Over the cap.
2026-10-30 GraphMP, a learning-based message-passing decoder for qLDPC codes, plus a decoder model factory. E-QEC. Simulation. Over the cap.

2026-10-30 FPGA belief-propagation decoder for a [[512,174,8]] 3D product qLDPC code. The abstract says the FPGA meets a neutral-atom and trapped-ion latency budget. E-QEC. Score next; do not treat that sentence as a measured logical qubit. Over the cap.
2026-10-30 Color-code magic-state synthesis and analog rotations, titled as run on a superconducting processor. E-QEC. Score next before the title is read as a measured logical. Over the cap.
2026-10-31 Photon-loss thresholds for the surface-GKP code. The abstract gives estimates at GKP squeezing of 20 dB and 13 dB. E-QEC. Over the cap.
2026-10-31 Decoder-agnostic logical-class diagnostic for abelian stabilizer codes. E-QEC. Over the cap.
2026-11-02 Routing for the [[144,12,12]] bivariate bicycle code on spin-qubit shuttling grids. E-QEC. Memory experiments in the abstract, not a device result scored here. Over the cap.
2026-11-02 Belief-propagation-guided Tesseract decoding of qLDPC codes. E-QEC. Over the cap.

2026-11-03 Reinforcement-learned scheduling for qLDPC belief-propagation decoders. Could be read as E-QEC and E-RL together. Do not ADD that coupling; a later card must keep it at C1 if both are bound. Over the cap.
2026-11-03 Asymptotic rate and distance for addressable transversal phase gates, using a cyclic encoding outside binary CSS. E-QEC theory, not a device. Over the cap.

2026-11-03 Decoding the transverse-field toric code as it is pushed toward a trivial phase. The abstract says bare stabilizer measurements still give a finite threshold under bit-flip and phase-flip noise. E-QEC. No threshold number is copied here. Over the cap.
2026-11-02 Gate-tunable coupling and zero-bias peaks in PbTe-Pb nanowires. E-MZM context. The abstract does not state an X and Z logical. Over the cap.
2026-11-03 Universal braiding in Links-Gould fusion spaces for U_q of sl(2|1). Not an S3 braid-plus-fusion measurement. Do not bind E-S3. Over the cap.
2026-11-03 Extended-MHD model of a passive runaway-electron mitigation coil on a high-current tokamak. Not a closed control loop and not an S-L3 solver. Over the cap.
